verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a SaaS contract platform, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question to ask of it. The pack has no evidence of region or residency selection. The closest item (ironclad-docs-43) describes using the API to copy signed agreements into your own internal system. That is a developer building block, not a residency control. The secure-storage marketing line (ironclad-docs-11) names no regions.
